mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, owner_context, export_type, operation_id, request_digest, actor_user_id, filter_snapshot, scope_snapshot, requested_fields_snapshot, include_files, scope_version, task_status, result_count, artifact_id, file_version_no, reference_key, artifact_version, reference_version, availability_version, file_hash, expires_at, failure_code, failure_retryable, retry_count, version, creator, create_time, updater, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO plt_export_task (id, tenant_id, owner_context, export_type, operation_id, request_digest, actor_user_id, filter_snapshot, scope_snapshot, requested_fields_snapshot, include_files, scope_version, task_status, retry_count, version, creator, create_time, updater, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{ownerContext}, #{exportType}, #{operationId}, #{requestDigest}, #{actorUserId}, #{filterSnapshot}, #{scopeSnapshot}, #{requestedFieldsSnapshot}, #{includeFiles}, #{scopeVersion}, #{taskStatus}, #{retryCount}, #{version}, #{creator}, #{createTime}, #{updater}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM plt_export_task WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND actor_user_id=#{query.actorUserId} AND id=#{query.taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE plt_export_task SET task_status='REQUESTED', failure_code=NULL, failure_retryable=NULL, retry_count=retry_count+1, version=version+1, updater=#{update.updater}, update_time=NOW() WHERE tenant_id=#{update.tenantId} AND id=#{update.taskId} AND version=#{update.expectedVersion} AND task_status='FAILED' AND failure_retryable=1
mapper.select: SELECT FROM plt_export_task WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND task_status='REQUESTED' ORDER BY create_time, id LIMIT #{query.limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT FROM plt_export_task WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND task_status='SUCCEEDED' AND expires_at <= NOW() ORDER BY expires_at, id LIMIT #{query.limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE plt_export_task SET task_status=#{update.targetStatus}, result_count=#{update.resultCount}, artifact_id=#{update.artifactId}, file_version_no=#{update.fileVersionNo}, reference_key=#{update.referenceKey}, artifact_version=#{update.artifactVersion}, reference_version=#{update.referenceVersion}, availability_version=#{update.availabilityVersion}, file_hash=#{update.fileHash}, expires_at=#{update.expiresAt}, failure_code=#{update.failureCode}, failure_retryable=#{update.failureRetryable}, version=version+1, updater=#{update.updater}, update_time=NOW() WHERE tenant_id=#{update.tenantId} AND id=#{update.taskId} AND version=#{update.expectedVersion} AND task_status=#{update.expectedStatus}
